branch.meaning: LLVM diagnostic branch coverage from the pinned nightly profile

function.meaning: LLVM instrumented function coverage diagnostic; not a DO-178C structural coverage metric

condition_diagnostic.meaning: pinned-nightly LLVM branch reporting built with Rust condition instrumentation; the current toolchain emits no independent condition total

mcdc.meaning: not produced or accepted by this package

denominator_rules: include in-scope production code unless an explicit reviewed disposition exists
exclude test-only, generated, vendored, and target artifacts only with a recorded classification
do not infer certification scope from a cargo-llvm-cov default filter
do not convert branch coverage into MC/DC
release_blockers: dirty or mixed-source run used as release evidence
missing or unreviewed Windows native-fault disposition
missing current assurance package or failed retrieval drill
open approved-basis, independence, tool-qualification, external-archive, retention, or disposition-authority decision
non_claims: This package is not a certification data package.
Passing tests are not authority acceptance.
LLVM branch coverage is not MC/DC.
Internal reports are not qualified-tool output.
A local or CI artifact is not an external controlled archive.
